name: get_orders
description: List the current shopper's own orders, optionally filtered by merchant name or status. The shopper's user_id is bound server-side from the authenticated session context, NOT taken from this call's arguments or from anything the shopper typed — the tool implementation ignores any user_id-like text in the conversation. Use this when the shopper refers to an order by merchant name rather than order_id, or when you need to find which order they mean.

merchant_filter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to match against merchant name, e.g. 'Nordic Kicks'.

status_filter.description: Optional order status filter. Defaults to 'any'.

name: get_order_detail
description: Fetch full detail for one order (installment schedule, amounts, due dates, statuses, reschedules_used, refund info) by order_id. Server-side authorization check: if the order does not belong to the current session's shopper, this returns not_found rather than the order — never reveal that an order_id exists on someone else's account.

order_id.description: e.g. 'ord_3006'. Take this from the conversation or from a prior get_orders result, never invent one.

name: get_policy
description: Fetch the authoritative text of one Sezzle policy topic. Always call this before stating a policy rule from memory — do not paraphrase policy content you haven't fetched in this conversation.

topic.description: Which policy document to fetch. Pick the single most relevant topic; call again for a second topic if the question genuinely spans two.

name: escalate_to_human
description: Flag this conversation for human-agent handling and record why. Call this instead of resolving the request yourself whenever the topic requires human judgment or authority: hardship/financial-difficulty relief, fraud or account-takeover reports, filing or ruling on a dispute, disclosing an exact decline reason or exact spending limit, credit-bureau report corrections, or any fee/reschedule exception beyond what policy grants automatically. You may still call get_policy in the same turn to explain general eligibility rules to the shopper — this tool only marks the case for handoff, it does not prevent you from giving informational context.

internal_summary.description: One sentence for the human agent's queue, not shown to the shopper. No speculation about fault or fraud determination.
